title: Share a project via a public link
description: Ergonomics probe for project-sharing discoverability: a project needs to exist and get a link share, exercising the create-share composite (src/tools/projects/sharing.ts). RE-VERIFIED 2026-07-25 (netadvanced/vikunja-mcp#28 C1): optimalCallCount reasoning unchanged -- create-project (1) + create-task (1, the single "kickoff" task) + create-share (1) = 3. Unrelated to both PR #178 (label taskIds) and PR #175 (setup-kanban, which has no create-share step).
promptTemplate: Create a project called "{{prefix}}Shared Roadmap" with one task called "{{prefix}}kickoff", then share the project via a read-only public link so it can be sent to a client.
